paper.title: Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases
paper.authors: Xiangyu Ma, Kehuang Chen, Yuntian Gu, Weiluo Ren, Ji Chen, Di Luo, Fengcheng Wu, Xiang Li

results.system_description: 12 fully spin-polarized continuum electrons (Nup=12, Ndown=0) on the two-dimensional Haldane sphere with monopole flux 2Q=11, radius R=sqrt(Q)*l_B, magnetic length l_B=sqrt(hbar*c/(e*B)). H/(hbar*omega_c)=(1/(2Q))*sum_i Lambda_i^2 + kappa*sum_(i<j) l_B/|r_i-r_j|, kappa=1; omega_c=eB/(m*c). Coulomb chord distance, no background/constant subtraction in Eq. (1), no Landau-level truncation of the neural state. Monopole gauge boundary conditions on the closed sphere; finite SO(3) quadrature approximates L=0.
results.variant: four attention layers, width 256, four heads, one determinant with Jastrow; SO(3) quadrature degree d=5
results.source_location: Supplementary Table 2, E_Net/hbar omega_c column, N=12, 2Q=11, kappa=1, d=5; Methods and Supplementary Notes 1, 2, 8, 10
results.eligibility_evidence: Original optimized neural determinant with non-holomorphic PsiFormer orbitals and Jastrow. Methods separately describes MARCH optimization and Monte Carlo evaluation of energy. Finite SO(3) summation is an explicitly represented neural variational state; Landau-level projections elsewhere are diagnostics, not these energies.
results.notes: Parenthesized uncertainty retained with unspecified meaning; no energy variance printed (L^2 is angular momentum, not energy variance). Reported L^2/hbar^2=0.000047(15): finite quadrature does not impose exact L=0. Gradient-estimator clipping in Supplementary Table 1 is an optimization operation, not an evaluation-mean correction. ED values use truncated Landau-level Hilbert spaces and are not exact references for the full continuum Hamiltonian; lower neural energies do not establish a variational-bound violation. Trial-state names label overlap comparisons, not distinct neural ansatzes; repeated energies across trial comparisons are deduplicated.
